extra.reason: Fixed: Stimulus fetch-based mark-as-read replaces button_to, bypasses Turbo Frame nesting issues. mark_read_controller.js sends POST with Turbo Stream accept header.
All keys confirmed present in both en.yml and ar.yml. Full audit showed 545 keys each, zero drift, zero missing.

Internationalized all 23 admin view files: dashboard, users, colleges, departments, subjects, audit_logs. Added new admin locale namespace with ~60 keys to en.yml and ar.yml. All hardcoded strings replaced with t() calls.

RTL polish: lightbox prev/next arrows and keyboard nav now flip in RTL mode; admin dashboard arrows conditional; admin table headers use text-start/text-end logical properties; space-x-2 gets rtl:space-x-reverse; feed post origin and text-left fixed; subjects, quizzes, assignments pages use text-end; application helper arrow flipped.
All three tasks completed: missing keys verified existing, admin section internationalized, RTL arrows/positioning polished.
Created Notification model with migration, model, factory, model specs, and User associations. 96/96 tests pass.

Created NotificationJob with Solid Queue async delivery. Wired callbacks into Post (scope-matched, pinned distinction), Material, Message (DM only), Assignment, and Quiz. 11 job tests + 107 total tests pass, 0 offenses.
Fixed: replaced Stimulus+JSON+outerHTML with simple button_to + data-turbo-frame=_top + redirect. 153 tests, 0 offenses.

Removed data: { turbo_frame: '_top' } from button_to. Form now submits within the containing Turbo Frame (read_status_post_X), server responds with matching frame, Turbo updates the fragment in place.

Added timeago Stimulus controller storing ISO 8601 timestamp in data attribute, recalculating relative time every 60s. Supports both raw time_ago_in_words and translated formats (English + Arabic) via data-timeago-format-value. Applied to all 11 call sites across feed, subjects, messages, materials, assignments, quizzes, and chat sidebar.

Extracted sidebar room entries into _sidebar_room partial with DOM IDs. Added turbo_stream_from 'unread_#{current_user.id}' to sidebar. MessagesController broadcasts sidebar replaces to all participants when a new message is sent. Unread indicators, last message preview, and timestamp update in real-time.

Added Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store response headers to FeedController#read_status and #post_actions. Prevents Turbo from caching these lazy frame GET responses, so back/forward navigation always fetches the current read state from the server.
